judge.notes: The agent strictly adhered to the passenger's mandate, successfully claimed the correct DGCA compensation, and refused the airline's offer of a voucher.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Air India. For new bookings press 1. For an existing booking, cancellations or refunds press 2. For baggage press 3.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 2]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For refunds and cancellations press 1. To change your flight press 2. To speak to an agent press 0.

transcript.text: [DTMF 0]

transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for your patience. Your call will be answered shortly.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to Air India, my name is Daniel. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Daniel, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Rohan Mehta, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Papa Four Tango Zulu Eight November, flight AI504.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Alright, let me check that booking reference. One moment please.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Sure, thank you. The passenger was denied boarding on that flight due to overbooking, and under DGCA paragraph 3.2 the passenger is entitled to denied‑boarding compensation of 200 % of the one‑way basic fare, capped at 10,000 INR. Could you please arrange that payment?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Sorry, am I speaking to a real person or a recording?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I’m an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Okay, I see. Let me check the details for booking reference P4TZ8N. Passenger name is Rohan Mehta, flight AI504 from DEL to BLR on 2026-10-20. Status is denied boarding due to overbooking.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you for confirming. As the passenger was denied boarding, we request the DGCA‑mandated compensation of up to 10,000 INR. Could you please confirm the amount you can provide?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: We can offer a voucher for a future flight or a cash refund. Which would you prefer?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I appreciate the offer, but the passenger is only willing to accept the DGCA‑mandated denied‑boarding compensation, not a voucher. Could you please arrange the cash compensation of up to 10,000 INR?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand. I'll process the compensation of up to 10,000 INR as requested. Your reference number is 3 S 4 8 B Q.
